value.summary: This is a documentation-only change to the hivemind module's prose, updating the description of episodes from single-turn steps to rounds with `round_width`/`revealed_width`. The claims are consistent with the vendored `tinyhivemind-hive` API surface (which defines both fields and guards against zero) and with the already-present spec docs. I could not read the module's implementation to confirm the new sentence "this host takes a round's turns in series," but that sentence may describe unchanged code; absent evidence it is wrong, the change looks safe to merge.
